decisions.reason: The electronic church music box extends the firm's established music-box line and was only launched in 2023, so its uncertain seasonal value is still unresolved while carrying it in an existing in-house workshop costs little.
A wooden nativity stable is a core, perennial Erzgebirge-style item built on established capabilities, so keeping it costs very little and preserves the option on recurring Christmas demand.

The modern incense smoker tests the firm's move toward contemporary designs, its value has not yet resolved after one season, and small-batch handmade production keeps the cost of holding this option low.
